# Phone Number Generator

> A free online tool to generate valid format fake phone numbers for testing and verification purposes. Supports US, UK, China, Japan, Germany, and more.

## Capabilities
- Generate valid format mobile and landline numbers
- Includes correct country codes and area codes
- Ideal for software testing, QA, and privacy verification
- Completely free and works offline (client-side generation)

## Core Tools
- [US Phone Number Generator](https://phone-number-generator.online/us-phone-number-generator.html)
- [China Phone Number Generator](https://phone-number-generator.online/china-phone-number-generator.html)
- [UK Phone Number Generator](https://phone-number-generator.online/uk-phone-number-generator.html)
- [Japan Phone Number Generator](https://phone-number-generator.online/japan-phone-number-generator.html)
- [Germany Phone Number Generator](https://phone-number-generator.online/germany-phone-number-generator.html)
